meta: Thank-you, shipping, review and reorder messages after every order, built in your tool. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Post-purchase flows that turn buyers into repeat customers
overview: The order is not the end of the story. We build the messages that follow it in your own email tool: a warm thank-you, how to use the product, a review request timed after delivery and a reorder reminder when it is likely to run out. Each message uses the order details so it reads as personal. We test with a real order and make sure unhappy customers go to support, not to a review prompt.

faq: Can the review request go to Google or Trustpilot?
Yes. We can link to the review site you choose. We ask every customer the same way and never filter to send only happy buyers to public reviews, because review platforms forbid that.
How do you time the review message?
We use the delivery date where your store records it, or a fixed delay after shipping. Asking before the parcel arrives leads to poor reviews, so timing is something we check carefully.
Will it clash with my shipping emails from the store?
We review both so they do not repeat each other. If your store already sends good shipping messages, we leave them in place and add our messages around them.
How does the reorder reminder know when to send?
We use how long your product usually lasts, which you tell us, such as 30 days for a supplement. You can change the timing per product later without our help.
